caption: The drawing depicts a sleeveless, knee-length waistcoat viewed from the front and the back. The primary focus is on the front view of the garment, which features an all-over geometric diamond pattern composed of light beige, blue, and yellow elements. The waistcoat has a standing collar and a central placket with buttons and bar-shaped buttonholes outlined in blue. There are six pockets — three on each side of the lower front — with rectangular flaps trimmed with blue lines and adorned with matching buttons. On the left side of the drawing, the waistcoat’s front edges curve slightly outward at the hem, while the back view, sketched lightly in pencil on the right, shows the back seam and an adjustable strap near the waist. The drawing is executed with pen, ink, and watercolor on cream-colored paper, and the artist's name, "J. Peszel," appears at the lower left corner.
title: Waistcoat
